user_stories.title: Create CommandResult dataclass with helper methods
acceptance_criteria: CommandResult dataclass is added to tools/auto_prd/command.py
CommandResult has three fields: stdout: str, stderr: str, exit_code: int
CommandResult.is_success() returns True when exit_code == 0, False otherwise
CommandResult.get_error_message() returns stderr.strip() if available, otherwise stdout.strip(), otherwise 'exit code N'
CommandResult.__iter__() enables tuple unpacking: stdout, stderr, exit_code = result
Dataclass can be instantiated: CommandResult('out', 'err', 0) works without errors
Module imports successfully: from tools.auto_prd.command import CommandResult
user_stories.notes: This is the foundation story. Add the dataclass after line 28 in command.py (after imports). Follow existing patterns from TaskResult (worker.py:43-50) and InitResult (initializer.py:32-46).

user_stories.title: Update run_cmd to return CommandResult
acceptance_criteria: run_cmd() function signature return type changes from -> tuple[str, str, int] to -> CommandResult
run_cmd() docstring return type is updated to describe CommandResult
Line 499: Success return returns CommandResult(stdout_text, stderr_text, proc.returncode)
Line 549: Failure return returns CommandResult(stdout_text, stderr_text, proc.returncode)
Module imports successfully after changes: from tools.auto_prd.command import run_cmd
Command with check=False returns CommandResult: result = run_cmd(['echo', 'hello'], check=False)
Tuple unpacking still works: out, err, code = run_cmd(['echo', 'test'], check=False)
Named attributes work: result = run_cmd(['echo', 'test'], check=False); print(result.stdout)
Failure case returns correct exit_code: result = run_cmd(['false'], check=False); assert result.exit_code == 1
user_stories.notes: This is the core change that affects all call sites. The __iter__() method from US-001 ensures backward compatibility. Update lines 360, 397, 499, and 549 in command.py.

run_sh() docstring return type mentions CommandResult
run_sh() correctly returns CommandResult from underlying run_cmd() call

user_stories.title: Verify backward compatibility with comprehensive tests
acceptance_criteria: Import test passes: python -c 'from tools.auto_prd.command import run_cmd, run_sh, CommandResult'
CommandResult instantiation test passes: result = CommandResult('out', 'err', 0); assert result.stdout == 'out'
Named attribute access test passes: result = run_cmd(['echo', 'hello'], check=False); assert result.stdout.strip() == 'hello'
Tuple unpacking test passes: stdout, stderr, exit_code = run_cmd(['echo', 'test'], check=False)
is_success() test passes: result = run_cmd(['false'], check=False); assert not result.is_success()
get_error_message() test passes: result = run_cmd(['sh', '-c', 'echo error >&2; exit 1'], check=False); assert 'error' in result.get_error_message()
run_sh returns CommandResult test passes: result = run_sh('echo hello from zsh', check=False); assert result.is_success()
Integration test with git operations passes: out, _, _ = run_cmd(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=Path.cwd())
All verification commands complete without exceptions
user_stories.notes: Create /tmp/test_command_result.py with the test cases from Phase 4 in plan.md. Run all verification commands to ensure no regressions.
